title: Mic lights up; per-card transcribe; archive and clear

text: Landed: every microphone shows a solid primary ring while it listens, with a small bar beside it that moves; the rail's box is typed-only and the mic lives on each card's page, with an auto-transcribe box beside + New card; cleared cards leave the rail and come back greyed under 'archived (n)'; page mentions are links. One thing honestly not done: sentences can still break at whisper's segment edges — the fix that was tried merged three sentences into one, so it was reverted and goes to tomorrow with the recordings workspace showing whisper's raw segments.
